hook: A shock can fade while its effect remains.
narration: Push one variable in a two-variable system. Each period, the same signed links pass part of the previous changes into the next changes. In the paper's stable example those changes fade. But adding them over time leaves a lasting displacement. Now change the feedback: persistence and explosive growth behave differently. These are reconstructions of declared model examples, not forecasts. Try the sliders in The Flow Observatory, and read the original paper.
